highlights.title: GCC 16 wrong-code fix
highlights.description: FreeCAD on NixOS crashed on a boolean subtract of a cube and an inscribed cylinder. The crash led through OpenCascade 7.9.3's point classifier to a wrong-code bug in GCC 16, where interprocedural constant propagation redirected a recursive call to a clone specialised for a different dynamic type, so the program ran the wrong virtual method. Bisected GCC to two January 2026 changes, reduced the miscompile to a C++ testcase of a few dozen lines, wrote the fix and a regression test, and bootstrapped and regtested GCC. The IPA maintainer reviewed it and pushed it to master the same day, with a GCC 16 backport planned. Around it, a nixpkgs workaround builds OpenCascade with `-fno-ipa-cp-clone` and fails the build if the miscompile returns, an OpenCascade issue asks for a 7.9 backport of its fix, and a FreeCAD PR backports OpenCascade 8 support to the 1.1 branch

highlights.title: GNU social v3
highlights.description: Led the GNU social v3 rewrite from 2021 to 2022 with ~1200 commits, funded by NLnet through the NGI0 Discovery programme. Ported the federated microblogging stack to Symfony 5 with an event driven and modular architecture. Rewrote the controllers and posting form layer, expanded PHPUnit coverage, and integrated PHPStan and tooling for dependency hygiene

highlights.title: Blender GSoC 2019
highlights.description: Proposed replacing Blender's Python OBJ, STL, and PLY importers/exporters with a shared C/C++ IO framework using memory-mapped files and optional parallelization. A prototype patch made OBJ and STL import and export about 3× faster, and the proposal was accepted into the GSoC programme

items.title: elanpress: support 04f3:0c6e
items.description: Added the ELAN 04f3:0c6e press sensor of the ASUS ROG Flow X13 to libfprint's new `elanpress` driver. On master it sits under the swipe-only `elan` driver, where enrolment fails with a protocol error and verify never matches. Two follow-up fixes keep a background frame captured with the finger down from becoming a touch, and keep more distinct probe frames per touch. Scored offline on a recorded session, 15 held-out touches of the enrolled finger matched at 0.848 to 0.954 and 47 touches from other fingers and another person stayed at 0.294 to 0.761, so no false accepts. inauman took all three commits into the branch behind [libfprint!654](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libfprint/libfprint/-/merge_requests/654) on 2026-10-20 and closed this one, so they now wait on upstream review there

items.title: fix(html): lex processing instructions in their own context
items.description: Biome's HTML lexer read the `?` before `>` as part of a name, so `<?xml version="1.0"?>` never closed and `astro check` rejected an SVG component that starts with an XML declaration ([withastro/compiler-rs#199](https://github.com/withastro/compiler-rs/issues/199)). Opened [#12159](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12159) with the fix and fixtures for the plain, Astro, Vue and Angular lexers. The maintainer landed a reworked version with me as co-author

items.title: ipa-cp: Check polymorphic contexts before redirecting to a clone [PR127917]
items.description: FreeCAD booleans crashed on NixOS because OpenCascade's bounding box tree walk ran the line selector's `Accept` on the point selector. GCC 16's IPA-CP had redirected a recursive call to a clone made for a different polymorphic context. Bisected it with prebuilt snapshots to two January changes, reduced it to two short C++ testcases, wrote the fix and a regression test, and bootstrapped and regtested on x86_64. The IPA maintainer reviewed it and pushed it to master the same day, with a GCC 16 backport to follow (bug 127917). A nixpkgs PR builds OCCT with `-fno-ipa-cp-clone` and adds an install check for the miscompile, an OpenCascade issue asks for the OCCT 8 fix to be backported to 7.9, and a FreeCAD PR backports its OpenCascade 8 support to the 1.1 branch

items.title: drm/client: Keep larger modes in connector->modes on fbdev hotplug
items.description: On an ASUS ROG Flow X13 booted with `video=eDP-1:1920x1200@60`, an HDMI hotplug made fbdev reprobe every connector with its 1920x1200 framebuffer as the limit. The 3840x2400 eDP panel lost its native mode from `connector->modes`, and after suspend/resume amdgpu drove it at 1920x1200 with the image squeezed into the top-left corner. Patch 1 makes `drm_client_modeset_probe()` probe with the device's mode size limits, as fbdev's first probe already does, and moves the framebuffer size check into the fbdev mode pickers. Patch 2 adds KUnit tests. v2 also checks the size of the CRTC's current mode before the firmware config falls back to it, which Sashiko found. With only this series applied, 255 of 255 resumes kept the native timing, against 28 of 29 wrong without it. Ville Syrjälä said on 2026-10-16 the approach should be fine but gave no tag, so it is still under review

items.title: drm/amd/display: Keep eDP native timing after resume with video=
items.description: Two patches on amd-gfx. After an HDMI hotplug and a suspend/resume, a 3840x2400 eDP panel booted with a `video=` mode came back squeezed into the top-left corner. The fbdev reprobe had dropped the native mode and amdgpu scaled onto the first one left. On eDP and LVDS the fix falls back to a listed mode of the native size, or else to the encoder's native mode, with KUnit tests that fail without it. On 7.2.8, 103 of 103 resumes were wrong before and 1363 of 1363 right after. v2 is rebased onto amd-staging-drm-next, as Tom Chung at AMD asked. A second series on dri-devel, `drm/client: Keep larger modes in connector->modes on fbdev hotplug`, fixes the same bug for every driver. Both are under review

items.title: drm/client: Don't print a NULL firmware config mode
items.description: When some tiles of a tiled display are missing, `drm_client_firmware_config()` swaps in `drm_connector_fallback_non_tiled_mode()`, which can return NULL, and the debug message after it still read `modes[i]->name`. It now prints `(none)` there, and drops the stray colon in `[CONNECTOR::%d:%s]` that broke grepping the log for a connector id. Sashiko found it while reviewing the fbdev hotplug series. Thomas Zimmermann suggested the v2 form and gave his Reviewed-by on 2026-10-23

items.title: fix(hotkey): wait in `poll()` between events instead of a 5 ms sleep
items.description: The evdev listener slept 5 ms between passes over its devices, so an idle daemon woke about 200 times a second to find nothing to read. It now blocks in `poll()` on the keyboard fds and the inotify watch, with a 100 ms timeout so the stop signal and the device checks still run, and handles key events as they arrive. On my laptop an idle daemon went from about 229 wakeups a second to about 42. A draft, waiting on CI approval and review

items.title: amdgpu_panel_power: Allow configuring the levels in the settings file
items.description: The action picks the panel's ABM level from the profile and the battery charge, with power-saver at 0 above 50% and balanced at 1 below 30%, and nobody could change it: one user wanted the saving at any charge (#185), others found level 3 too strong (#159). Adds a `load_settings` vfunc so an action reads its own group from `power-profiles-daemon.conf`, with `PowerSaverLevel`, `BalancedLevel` and `PerformanceLevel` keys that apply on battery at any charge; unset keys keep today's steps, and unknown groups, keys or values out of 0 to 4 get a warning. A first commit fixes a leak already on main, where both error returns in `set_panel_power()` skipped freeing the drm device list. Measured on an ASUS ROG Flow X13: level 4 saves 0.4 to 0.6 W of about 10.4 W. Stacked on !241

items.title: Save the user's action and battery-aware choices correctly
items.description: power-profiles-daemon saved an action as off whenever it was inactive for one run, so a `--block-action` debug flag or a failed probe switched it off for good in `state.ini`, and a `configure-action` choice was lost if the daemon stopped before the next profile change. The first commit keeps the state file to the user's own choices instead of what is active right now; the second writes it as soon as `configure-action` or `configure-battery-aware` runs. Seven new integration tests cover the blocked, opt-in and failed-probe cases and the restarts; all 152 pass

items.title: opencascade-occt: build with `-fno-ipa-cp-clone` on GCC 16
items.description: GCC 16 at `-O3` miscompiles OCCT 7.9.3. Classifying a point on an edge or vertex of a solid segfaults, and so do booleans where faces touch along a line, which is how FreeCAD crashed on a boolean subtract of a cube and an inscribed cylinder. Builds OCCT with `-fno-ipa-cp-clone` when the compiler is GCC 16 or newer and adds an install check that runs the failing classification, so the build fails if the miscompile comes back

items.title: Read the daemon options from `power-profiles-daemon.conf`
items.description: Blocking a driver or an action meant overriding `ExecStart` in a systemd drop-in, which breaks when a distribution installs the daemon elsewhere or changes the unit. The daemon now looks for `power-profiles-daemon.conf` and a `.conf.d/` directory in `/etc`, `/run`, `/usr/local/lib` and `/usr/lib`, in systemd's order and with systemd's rules: a later key replaces an earlier one, a drop-in of the same name higher up masks the lower one, a link to `/dev/null` masks a file, and files are opened without blocking and read rather than mapped so a FIFO or a truncated file cannot stop startup. The `[Daemon]` group takes `BlockDrivers` and `BlockActions`, and unknown keys, groups and names get a warning. A second commit makes `SetActionEnabled` refuse to turn on a blocked action instead of reporting success

items.title: fix: switch tabs on touchscreen taps
items.description: Tapping a tab on a touchscreen did not switch to it, and the tab bar could disappear until a new window opened, because the click handler only listened to mouse buttons, which Hyprland never raises for touch. Moves the lookup into `Hy3Layout::tabAt()` and calls it from an `input.touch.down` listener too; a tap on a tab cancels its down, motion and up events so the client underneath never sees the touch, and the listener repeats Hyprland's own checks for the locked session, kill mode, workspace swipes and covering surfaces. Tested in a VM with a virtual touchscreen and earlier on a real one

items.title: fix: crash on plugin unload with tab groups open
items.description: Unloading hy3 with a tab group open crashed Hyprland on the next animation tick, which any reload that changes the plugin path triggers, such as a NixOS switch that rebuilds hy3. Hyprland calls PLUGIN_EXIT first and removes the layouts after, and removing them put fading tab groups back on a list whose tick listener was already gone. Removes the layout at the start of PLUGIN_EXIT so the clears free what is left, and drops the tab pass element from the render pass as hyprbars does. Tested in a VM through an unload, a reload and six swaps between builds

items.title: fix: guard workspace monitor before dereferencing it
items.description: When the last monitor disconnects, Hyprland leaves workspaces pointing at the monitor it is destroying, and hy3 dereferenced that pointer on the next window map or unmap and segfaulted. Checks the workspace's monitor in `insertNode`, `recalcGeometry`, `moveNodeToWorkspace` and the tab group constructor, and the focused monitor in the dispatchers and cursor warp, which is null while no monitor is connected; each place skips its monitor work. Fixes #332 and #336

items.title: feat(audio): keep recording after a stop until the mic goes quiet
items.description: Letting go of push-to-talk a moment early cut the last word, and Whisper dropped it or guessed. With `audio.stop_tail_ms` set, the daemon keeps capturing after the stop until the last 160 ms are quiet, for at most that long; a clean release stops at once. Quiet is three times the recording's noise floor, taken as its 10th-percentile frame and capped where quiet speech starts, so the bar follows the mic and the room. Off by default, with a schema entry, a field in the configure TUI, docs and a unit test

items.title: perf(output): keep keyboard devices open between dictations
items.description: The modifier guard opened every `/dev/input/event*` node on each paste and closed them all afterwards, and each close waits for a kernel RCU grace period of 10 to 35 ms, so the guard alone added a few hundred milliseconds before every output (#543). Keyboards now stay open in a process-wide cache; each call still lists `/dev/input` and opens only nodes that are new or re-created, told apart by inode, so hotplug keeps working, and any close runs on a background thread off the output path

items.title: fix(whisper): drop the copy when a reduced audio context restarts the transcript
items.description: With context window optimisation on, Whisper sometimes reaches the end of the speech and transcribes the clip again from the start, returning the transcript twice or with its opening sentence repeated at the end; the loop check from #827 needs three copies, so these got through. If the first pass used a reduced `audio_ctx` and the text ends with a copy of its first six or more words, the text before the copy is kept, with no second pass. Replaying 20 archived dictations on large-v3-turbo, the three that came back doubled now match the full-context output at no extra cost. Stacked on #827

items.title: feat(daemon): record the next push-to-talk dictation while one transcribes

items.title: fix(whisper): retry when the decoder loops on a phrase
items.description: Added a loop check to the Whisper transcriber. When a phrase of three or more words repeats three or more times in a row, it retries with beam search, and keeps one copy of each phrase if the retry loops too

items.title: Quarter: scale pointer position to device pixels before flipping Y

items.title: fix(astro2tsx): print processing instructions as comments
items.description: With the Biome lexer fix, `<?xml version="1.0"?>` parses as an `HtmlProcessingInstruction` in Astro files, and `astro2tsx` copied it into the TSX verbatim, where TypeScript cannot parse `<?`. It now prints each instruction as a JSX comment through the path HTML comments use, at the root before the doctype and inside elements. New snapshot fixtures and a type-check test cover it, and `astro check` on the repro went from 7 errors to 0. Closes [#199](https://github.com/withastro/compiler-rs/issues/199). Closed in favour of [#205](https://github.com/withastro/compiler-rs/pull/205), which the maintainer merged with the same `astro2tsx` change

items.title: [Backport releases/FreeCAD-1-1] Adapt FreeCAD to OpenCascade 8

Tested with `FreeCADCmd -t 0` on OCCT 8.0.1 and 7.9.3, 1666 tests with the same results as 1.1.4, and the cube minus cylinder recomputes instead of crashing. The maintainers closed it, since the 1.1 branch gets no further releases and 26.3 is the first version to support OCCT 8

items.title: fix(output): keep the text on the clipboard when the modifier guard skips a paste
items.description: In paste mode the output chain held only the paste method. When a modifier was still down past `modifier_release_timeout_ms`, the guard skipped the paste and nothing else ran, so the dictation was lost although the notification said it was copied to the clipboard. Hit with Right Ctrl as the hotkey. Added `wl-copy` after the paste, as type mode already has, with a test that the chain keeps a method that survives the keystroke filter. Closed as a duplicate of [#588](https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype/pull/588) and [#654](https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype/pull/654)
